mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation_run ( run_id, user_id, eval_set_version, eval_set_hash, git_commit, prompt_version, rule_version, model_version, total_traces, avg_score, metric_snapshot, baseline_run_id, is_baseline, baseline_name, passed, created_at ) VALUES ( #{runId}, #{userId}, #{evalSetVersion}, #{evalSetHash}, #{gitCommit}, #{promptVersion}, #{ruleVersion}, #{modelVersion}, #{totalTraces}, #{avgScore}, #{metricSnapshot}, #{baselineRunId}, #{baseline}, #{baselineName}, #{passed}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id, user_id, eval_set_version, eval_set_hash, git_commit, prompt_version, rule_version, model_version, total_traces, avg_score, metric_snapshot, baseline_run_id, is_baseline, baseline_name, passed, created_at FROM evaluation_run WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND run_id = #{runId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, run_id, user_id, eval_set_version, eval_set_hash, git_commit, prompt_version, rule_version, model_version, total_traces, avg_score, metric_snapshot, baseline_run_id, is_baseline, baseline_name, passed, created_at FROM evaluation_run WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND eval_set_version = #{evalSetVersion} AND eval_set_hash = #{evalSetHash} AND is_baseline = 1 AND passed = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
